stacking.note: No hardware stacking. Cloud-managed via the Meter dashboard

routing.summary: Layer 2 fiber access/aggregation edge with VLANs (up to 4K)

power.summary: Single fixed internal AC PSU 12V/5A (60W total)

redundancy.detail: Fixed internal PSU; no redundant option listed

licensing: Included with Meter Network as a Service. Hardware is provisioned and managed as part of the Meter subscription rather than sold as standalone switches with a separate license SKU
verifyNote: Packet buffer published as 16M bits. Half-width chassis (210 mm); confirm rack-mount kit availability

models.note: 12x 1/10G SFP/SFP+. Half-width chassis (210 x 230 x 42.5 mm). No copper access ports
